brainlife.desc: Tractogram as a TrackVis .trk file (1000-byte header with reference volume geometry, then streamlines).
brainlife.name: neuro/track/trk

original.desc: TrackVis (.trk). Track file is one single binary file, with the first 1000 bytes as the header and the rest as the body.

brainlife.readme:
**Use for:** Input to DIPY tools such as RecoBundles, BUAN profiles and streamline registration. Conversion to .tck or TinyTrack for MRtrix and DSI Studio Apps.

**Not for:** Apps expecting MRtrix .tck without conversion. Assuming the header space matches another image without checking its affine.

**BIDS:** no BIDS counterpart.

**Sharing:** Tier 2 (pseudonymised participant-level) by default.

**Apps:** Input to 9 Apps, output of 13 Apps.

Full record: https://github.com/brainlife/abcd-spec/blob/master/datatypes/neuro.track.trk.json

identifying_risks: Individual white matter geometry can support re-linkage as a structural fingerprint
Headers and metadata may carry subject codes or acquisition dates
governance.rationale: Tool 1 step 4: participant-level processed neurodata without direct identifiers. Tier 4 conditions apply if used as a connectome fingerprint.
sharing_cautions: Share with coded subject IDs under a data use agreement
Strip free-text tags and dates from metadata before release
tier_conditions: Tier 1 only once aggregated across participants (e.g. a population atlas)
Tier 4 if used to build connectome fingerprints or predictive features
